Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES

Topic 2.1: School environment environment

Hello learner! Today we will learn about School environment environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.
